steps.text: Raise throttle gently. Hold above 1 m for 2 seconds.
Follow the arrow through gate 1. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Follow the arrow through gate 2. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Follow the arrow through gate 3. Leave clearance from walls and overhead obstacles.
Slow down in an open area, lower throttle and hold a safe landing for two seconds.
